exposure: circulating thyroid hormone levels (total thyroxine (T4), free thyroxine (fT4), total triiodothyronine (T3), thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH), T4-binding globulin (TBG))
change over time (delta, D) in hormone levels
outcome: neurodevelopmental outcome (Bayley Scales of Infant Development (BSID)-II)
cohort: The study included 120 preterm infants with a gestational age of less than 37 weeks.
finding: A negative evolution in circulating thyroid hormone levels, influenced by gestational age and dopamine, is an immaturity phenomenon temporarily associated with an increased risk for an abnormal mental developmental score at 9 months corrected age in preterm infants.
